candidates.name: VCABM
candidates.reason: Existing AdaptiveAdams implements owned order-3–5 PECE and source neighbor decisions. Full order-1–12 startup/FSAL/rejection policy is a distinct controller. Warm 1–12 polynomial operations are now prototyped; current monomial/cardinal reconstruction becomes ill-conditioned at high orders. Extending the integer range would make an unqualified order claim, especially with DP5 startup above order six.
candidates.revisit_condition: Stable divided-difference/Nordsieck history with high-order startup, accepted/rejected transition oracle and measured equal-error benefit beyond the bounded backend.

candidates.revisit_condition: A separate solver-cache invalidation/refresh protocol plus complete failure/retry/discontinuity trajectory oracle; no frontend dependency.

candidates.name: NordsieckBDF
candidates.reason: The source exists and propagates accepted Nordsieck arrays, with nonlinear tolerance budget and Jacobian reuse tied to local error. candidates.name: AN5
candidates.reason: Actual source coefficient/Pascal/rescale kernels are independently checked at orders 1–12; bounded warm corrector prototype has known polynomial/AD/order gates. Source AN5 uses Tsit5 interpolant startup and at most three functional iterations; JVODE adds mutable order/wait/rewind policy. Neither complete runtime is advertised. JVODE_BDF only adds BDF handling in order-change memory while sharing Adams coefficient preparation; do not label the warm Adams map a BDF port.
candidates.revisit_condition: Owned startup/rewind/order state and independent full trajectories through failure and step changes; stiff BDF needs its own verified corrector.

candidates.name: AMF
candidates.reason: Approximate matrix factorization is an ordered product of split Jacobian factors, not Adams. The dense product prototype checks noncommuting order and O(shift²) difference from the exact Rosenbrock matrix. Replacing the exact solve can alter method order; existing exact-JVP Rosenbrock does not silently accept approximate factors.
candidates.revisit_condition: Structured factor update/solve/transpose/gradient ownership, W-method order gates and measured benefit; generic RHS.linear alone is insufficient.

candidates.name: RKIP
candidates.reason: Source is Runge–Kutta in the interaction picture, not Krylov-implicit Rosenbrock. Dense RK4 coordinate prototype is order-four and exact on linear problems. exp(-c*h*L) can overflow for stiff negative diffusion, unlike forward-only ETDRK maps.
candidates.revisit_condition: A reversible/skew-operator consumer and bounded forward/backward exponential action contract; source adaptive/tableau/cache handling then needs separate gates.

candidates.name: IRKC
candidates.reason: Actual pinned constant-cache recurrence with independent dense nonlinear solves reproduces the tensor translation but converges near order one on the retained nonlinear/time split control at degrees 2/4/10. Source also comments out nonlinear-failure checks. Retain as an audit specimen, not a second-order production option.
candidates.revisit_condition: Corrected source or separately derived recurrence with split nonlinear/time order, failure propagation and joint stability-region evidence.
